inicio.titulo: ObraFácil: construction management app and site diary
inicio.descricao: Construction management app for mobile and computer: project programme, site diary with photos, project finances, team and a client portal. Start free.

ajuda.descricao: Step-by-step guides for the ObraFácil construction management app: site diary, programme, project finances, team and client portal, with real app screens.

app.descricao: Construction management app for builders, contractors, civil engineers and architects: stage-by-stage project programme, site diary (daily reports) with photos and PDF, project finances, team and payroll, purchases and stock, and a portal where the client follows the project. Works on Android, iPhone, Windows and the web, even offline on site.
